cohort: The study included 208 women from Taleghani Hospital, Arak, Iran, 104 of whom had vaginal delivery with episiotomy and 104 who underwent planned caesarean section.
finding: Mode of childbirth did not significantly influence pelvic floor muscle strength 1-3 years postpartum, with no significant difference observed between vaginal delivery with episiotomy and planned caesarean section groups.
mod_finding: Mode of childbirth (vaginal delivery with episiotomy or planned caesarean section) did not significantly influence pelvic floor muscle strength 1-3 years postpartum, and caesarean section did not demonstrate a protective effect on PFMS.
